scenes.text: Imagine walking through the beautiful, historic streets of Paris today, only to suddenly realize that the entire city around you is actually a complete lie.
Back in 1918 during the massive chaos of World War I, French authorities faced a terrifying threat of devastating German bomber planes attacking them at night.
To protect the real City of Light, they secretly built a second, completely fake Paris a few miles away, complete with replica wooden buildings, canvas streets, and even fake railway stations.

They even installed complex lighting systems to mimic glowing factories, successfully baiting enemy pilots into dropping bombs on empty fields, so tell me in the comments if you would have been fooled and hit follow!
